home.title: BA Modding Toolkit Web
home.subtitle: Blue Archive Modding Toolkit Web Version
home.instruction1: A session ID will be automatically assigned and saved in your browser
home.instruction2: Upload files and submit tasks, the system will process in background
home.instruction3: You can close the page and come back within 24 hours to check status and download results
home.instruction4: All files will be automatically cleaned up after 24 hours

features.updateDesc: Update old mods to the latest game version
features.crcDesc: Fix or check file CRC values
features.splitDesc: Distribute legacy bundle assets to multiple modern bundles
features.mergeDesc: Merge multiple modern bundle assets into a legacy bundle

update.title: Mod Update
update.description: Upload old Mod file and new game resource file, the system will migrate resources from old Mod to new file. Supports batch update — upload multiple files and they will be auto-matched by character name.
update.oldModHintLabel: Upload old Mod's .bundle file(s) to extract resources
update.targetBundleHintLabel: Upload new game's .bundle file(s) to inject resources (Android-Steam cross-platform supported)
update.oldModHint: Drop or click to select old Mod file(s) (.bundle)
update.targetBundleHint: Drop or click to select new game bundle(s) (.bundle)
update.crcCorrectionDesc: Correct CRC value of output file for game validation
update.strategyHintLine1: - path_id: For same-version files, most accurate replacement
update.strategyHintLine2: - cont_name_type: Match by container+name+type, suitable for cross-version migration (between global and JP servers)

pack.title: Asset Pack
pack.description: Upload asset files and target Bundle, the system will pack assets into the target Bundle.
pack.targetBundleHintLabel: Upload target game's .bundle file to inject assets into
pack.assetFolderHint: Drop or click to select asset files
pack.targetBundleHint: Drop or click to select target Bundle file (.bundle)

extract.title: Asset Extract
extract.description: Upload Bundle file, the system will extract specified asset types from it.
extract.bundleFileHintLabel: Upload game's .bundle file, the system will extract and package resources for download
extract.bundleFileHint: Drop or click to select Bundle file

crc.title: CRC Tool
crc.description: Upload the modified Bundle file and the original Bundle file. The system will correct the CRC value of the modified file to match the original.
crc.modifiedFileHintLabel: Upload modified .bundle file that needs CRC fix
crc.originalFileHintLabel: Upload original unmodified game .bundle file to provide CRC value
crc.modifiedFileHint: Drop or click to select modified Bundle file (needs CRC fix)
crc.originalFileHint: Drop or click to select original Bundle file (provides target CRC)
crc.checkOnlyDesc: Only calculate CRC, do not fix

split.title: Split Convert
split.description: Distribute assets from a legacy bundle into multiple modern bundle files.
split.legacyFileHint: Drop or click to select legacy bundle file (.bundle)
split.modernFilesHint: Drop or click to select modern bundle files (.bundle)
split.modernFilesHintLabel: Upload modern .bundle files, assets will be distributed to these files
split.crcCorrectionDesc: Correct CRC value of output files

merge.title: Merge Convert
merge.description: Merge assets from multiple modern bundles into a legacy bundle file.
merge.legacyFileHint: Drop or click to select legacy bundle file (.bundle)
merge.legacyFileHintLabel: Upload legacy .bundle file as base, assets will be injected into it
merge.modernFilesHint: Drop or click to select modern bundle files (.bundle)
merge.modernFilesHintLabel: Upload modern .bundle files to extract assets from
merge.crcCorrectionDesc: Correct CRC value of output files

spinePreview.title: Spine Animation Preview
spinePreview.description: Upload Bundle files to automatically extract and preview Spine animations in the browser. Supports animation switching and playback controls.
spinePreview.bundleFileHint: Drag and drop or click to upload .bundle files
spinePreview.unsupportedFileType: Unsupported file type, please upload .bundle files
spinePreview.pleaseUploadBundle: Please upload a Bundle file first
spinePreview.noSpineAssets: No Spine assets (.skel/.atlas) found. Please ensure the Bundle contains Spine animations
spinePreview.saveImageFailed: Failed to save image, canvas not found

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionHint: Refreshing extends the session expiry. Resetting creates a new session ID — previous tasks and files will no longer be accessible.
settings.resetConfirm: This will create a new session. Tasks and files from the current session will no longer be accessible. Continue?
